༄༅/ /yang zab bla ma sgrub pa las/phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas bzhugs so/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma mchog/'gro ba skyob byed la btud nas/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas bzhugs so//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma mchog /'gro ba skyob byed la btud nas// lam zab bla sgrub zab mo yi// phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas bshad// smin lam dbang gis rgyud sbyangs pa'i// slob ma mos ldan 'ga' zhig tshogs// mal stan bde ba la 'khod cing*// bsam gtan chos bdun dang ldan pas// dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang*// de dag mi rtag 'chi ba bsgom// thun dang po'o// rgyu 'bras dkar nag rtsis gdab dang*// ngan song 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam// thun gnyis pa'o// rang mdun gyad dang seṅge'i khrir// dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rdo rje 'chang gi tshul can dag /rdo rje snyems ma yum dang 'khyud// g.yas su sangs rgyas longs sku'i tshul// rgyab tu dam chos sher phyin yum// g.yon du byang sems dge 'dun tshogs// mdun du yi dam lhag pa'i lha// khri yi mdun du chos srung gsal// mchod bstod skyabs 'gro ci 'grub dang*// bla ma mchog gsum yi dam srung ma la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la sman slad sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa brgya phrag la sogs pa// ci 'grub ma yeng ngang nas bzla/ */rjes su skyabs yul mi bsdu bar// rang sar gsal gdab srung 'khor mchog /thun gsum pa'o// rang gi spyi bor bla ma ni// he ru ka dpal rdor sems sku// dung mdog dar dang rin chen rgyan// rus pas brgyan cing g.yas brkyang tshul// rdo rje dril bcas yum la 'khyud// yum ni rdo rje snyems ma dkar// gri gug thod 'dzin yab la 'khril// rgyan chas yab 'dra yab kyi ni// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ gi mthar// yig brgya mu tig phreng 'dras bskor// de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa// spyan drangs bstim zhing slar 'od kyis// dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur zhing*// rigs lngas rgyas gdab dbang lha bstim// mchod cing bstod pa dag byas te// de la sems gtad dar cig bsgom// slar yang yig brgya bzlas pa'i tshe// sngags phreng sa bon bcas pa las// 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod// de yi thugs rje ma lus pa// 'od kyi rnam par bsdus la bstim// slar yang 'od 'phros 'gro drug la// phog pas nyes sgrib dri ma'i tshogs// bkrus shing dag nas lha skur bsgyur// kun kyang yig brgya bzla bar bsam// 'od zer tshur bsdus thim ma thag

/sngags phreng sa bon bcas pa las// 'od dkar bdud rtsi'i rgyun zag pa// yab yum mkha' gsang la 'khril zhing*// de nyid chu rgyun ltar zag pa// rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs tshe// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon tshogs// dud khu sol khu'i rnam pa ru// 'og sgo gnyis dang ba spu yi// khung nas chil gyis rab thon cing*// lus kun 'od dkar des gang nas// dri bral shel sgong bzhin gyur bsam// de ltar dmigs gsal yig brgya ni// brgya stong khri phrag ci 'grub bzla// thun mthar gsol ba 'di skad gdab// mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs// zhes pas gsol ba lan gsum gdab// rdor sems dgyes tshul 'dzum bcas kyis// rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag go// zhes pa'i gnang ba dgyes bstsal nas// sku lus stod smad nas zhu ba// sngags phreng la thim de nyid kyang*// 'od zhu tshangs pa'i bu gar zhugs// rang lus dag pa'i ngo bor bsam// thun bzhi pa'o// slar yang rang mdun nam mkha' ru// tshogs zhing sngar gyi skyabs yul ltar// gsal btab mchod pa kun gyis mchod// de nas maṇ+ḍal 'di skad 'bul/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dri med gling bzhi gling phran 'khor yug bcas// rin chen nyi zla rgya mtsho ljon shing tshogs// me tog sman 'bras ji snyed mchis pa kun// phyi yi maṇ+ḍal rgyal ba rnams la 'bul// hūm̐ hrīḥ rang lus phung khams skye mched yul snang bcas// gdos bcas 'dzin grub sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs// bkod legs yid 'ong mchod pa'i tshogs spros pa'i// nang gi maṇ+ḍal rgyal ba rnams la 'bul// hūm̐ hrīḥ thabs shes bde stong dga' ba'i rol pa ni// yab yum snyoms 'jug gsang ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// 'dzad med dga' skyed rmad byung rol pa'i tshogs// gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal rgyal ba rnams la 'bul// hūm̐ hrīḥ

phyi nang dbyer med de nyid mtha' bzhi bral// mchod bya mchod byed ngo bo gnyis med pa// rang rig rang rtsal bden don gshis babs ngang*// don dam maṇ+ḍal rgyal ba rnams la 'bul// sku gsum yongs rdzogs la sogs dang*// gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal rgyas dang bsdus// rang gis shes tshad kun 'bul zhing*// yan lag bdun pa zlos bzhin pas// brgya phrag phyag dang bskor ba bya// mthar ni tshogs zhing 'od zhu ba// rang la thim bsam mnyam par bzhag /thun lnga pa'o// rang mdun gyad dang seṅge'i khrir// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin| |rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs can// sdo bsangs rdor dril thugs kar bsnol// rdo rje skyil krung 'gying tshul bzhugs// dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// de la rtsa brgyud bla mas bskor| |char sprin lta bur 'khrigs dmigs nas// mchod cing mos dang gus pa bskyed// dang bas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab// dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug /dwags po bka' brgyud yongs kyi gtsug rgyan// 'gro ba'i ded dpon dam pa'i lam ston// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab// bka' drin zla bral ston pa zla med/ rdo rje 'chang dbang mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po mkhyen no// gsol ba 'debs so// thugs rjes gzigs shig /byin gyis rlobs shig /dngos grub rnam gnyis/ da lta stsol cig /don gnyis lhun grub/ 'bras bu stsol cig /ces gsol 'debs brgya phrag sogs dang*// ma yeng gus pas rtse gcig gdab// dbang gi don du 'di skad gsol// dpal ldan bla ma mtshan rnams kun rang bzhin| |bdag gi spyi bor lus kyi thig le la// nye bar zhugs nas bum dbang dga' ba'i chus// sad pa'i bag chags dag par mdzad du gsol// de skad gsol gdab bla ma yi// dpral ba'i 'od dkar tshur 'phros pa/ bdag gi dpral bar thim ma thag /bum dbang thob nas sprul skur smin// longs spyod rdzogs pa sems can kun gyi skad// bdag gi mgrin par ngag gi thig le la// nye bar zhugs nas gsang bdag mchog dga'i mes// rmi lam bud shing bsreg par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol bla ma'i mgrin pa nas// 'od dmar bdag gi mgrin par thim// ngag dang rmi lam dri ma dag

/gsang dbang thob nas longs skur smin// rje btsun bla ma mi rtog chos kyi sku// bdag gi snying khar yid kyi thig le la// nye ba zhugs nas shes rab ye shes kyi// gnyid 'thug mun pa sangs par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol thugs nas 'od mthing byung*// rang snying thim pas yid sgrib dag /gnyid 'thug gti mug tshogs dag nas// sher dbang thob nas chos skur smin// 'gro ba'i mgon po lhan cig skyes pa'i sku// bdag gi lte bar ye shes thig le la// nye bar zhugs nas shes rab chen po'i dbang*// bskur bas 'pho med dga' ba thob par mdzod// ces gsol lte ba'i 'od zer dag /rang lter thim pas sgo gsum dang*// 'pho ba'i sgrib sbyangs tshig dbang thob| |ngo bo nyid skur smin par bsam// slar yang gsol ba 'di skad gdab// kun tu bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can gyi// gdod ma'i lus ngag yid dang ye shes rnams// khyod kyi rdo rje bzhi dang mnyam sbyor bas// mchog bde mngon du 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di'i dbang bzhi'i gsol 'debs dpal ldan bla ma mtshan rnams zhes pa nas 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol yan chad kyi sho lo ka lnga tshig bar dgu re yod pa 'di rnams bla sgrub gzhung rang rkang las byung ba min yang rung mthun du bdag rang gis kha bskangs pa yin no// zhes gsol 'khor tshogs 'od zhu nas// gtso la thim zhing gtso bo yang*// 'od zhu rang gi spyi bor thim// mnyam par bzhag cing ngal gso bya// thun drug pa'o// dngos gzhi bla ma phyi ltar du// sprul pa'i sku ru bsgrub pa ni// rang snying dbus su muṃ ser po// me 'od 'bar ba cher 'bar ba'i// rang lus gdos bcas phung khams dang*// skye mched bcas pa bsregs shing sbyangs// stong pa'i ngang las rang rig ni// muṃ ser 'od 'bar gnas pa'i ngang*// khyad par seṅge brgyad kyis ni// legs par bteg pa'i khri steng du// pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i steng*// rang rig muṃ yig yongs gyur las// ston pa shākya'i rgyal po ni// gser sbyangs dbur ma ltar 'tsher zhing*// phyag g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag

/sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum// li khri'i mdog can legs mnabs shing*// mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cus rab mdzes shing*// lta bas chog mi shes pa'i sku// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'bar ba// de yi ba spu'i khung rnams su// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis// gtso bo dang mtshungs rab tu bzhugs// snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa// lhun grub 'od kyi sku ru gsal// de dag yin rlom ma yin par// gsal snang nges pa rnyed par bya'o// thun bdun pa'o// slar yang mtshan sngags bzla ba'i phyir// rang nyid bstan pa'i bdag po ni// dpral bar zla dkyil dkar po'i lter// oṃ mthar mtshan sngags dkar pos bskor// mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i lter// */āḥlas sngags phreng dmar pos bskor/ */thugs kar nyi dkyil 'od 'bar dbus/ */hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng mthing gas bskor/ */de ltar gsal btab ngag tu ni// oṃ āḥgu ru shrī shākya mu ni rat+na shrī dharma kīrti karma bi dza ya se na ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes bzla dpral ba'i sngags phreng las// zla 'od lta bu'i 'od 'phros pas// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'gro rnams kyi// gti mug dri ma kun sbyangs nas// sku yi rdo rje mngon byas bsam// mtshan sngags brgya stong ci 'grub bzla// slar yang sngags bzlas mgrin pa yi// sngags las glog stong 'gyu 'dra ba'i// 'od phreng dmar pos 'gro rnams kyi// 'dod chags dri ma kun sbyangs nas// gsung gi rdo rje mngon byas bsam// mtshan sngags brgya stong ci 'grub bzla| |slar yang sngags bzlas thugs ka yi// sngags las 'od mthing rab 'phros pas// 'gro ba rnams kyi zhe sdang gi// dri ma dag cing thugs rdo rje'i// go 'phang thob par rab dmigs nas// mtshan sngags brgya stong ci 'grub bzla// thun brgyad pa'o// slar yang dpral ba'i sngags phreng las// 'od dkar 'phros pas rang nyid kyi// mgrin pa yan chad rab gang bas| |gdos bcas gzung 'dzin dri ma dag

/'od dkar 'o mtsho 'khyil ltar bsam// mtshan sngags bzla zhing dmigs pa bsgom// mgrin pa'i sngags phreng 'od dmar 'phros// snying ga yan gang ngag 'chal dang*// rdzun gyi nyes pa kun dag nas// 'od dmar rgya mtsho 'khyil ltar bsam// mtshan sngags bzla zhing dmigs pa gsal// thugs ka'i sngags las 'od mthing 'phros| |rkang mthil yan gang ngar 'dzin dang*/ 'jig tshogs lta ba kun sbyangs nas// 'od mthing nam mkha' lta bur bsam// mtshan sngags bzla zhing de nyid bsgom// thun dgu pa'o| |slar yang gnas gsum sngags rnams las// dkar dmar mthing kha'i 'od 'phros pas// ba spu'i skal bzang rnams la phog /de rnams kyi yang gnas gsum du// zla pad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ mthar mtshan sngags ni// dkar dmar mthing khar gsal rnams las// 'od phreng sna tshogs phyogs kun 'phros// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi// byin rlabs nus mthu ye shes dang*// snod bcud rnams kyi tshe bcud tshogs// 'od phreng sna tshogs kyis bkug nas// rang gi gnas gsum sngags la thim// byin rlabs tshe bsod rgyas par bsam// bzlas pa'i rgyun la 'bad par bya// thun bcu pa'o// de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni// skal bzang tshogs rnams 'od zhu ba// rang gnas gsum gyi sngags la thim// thub pa 'od zhu gnas gsum gyi// sngags la thim zhing sngags phreng rnams// so so'i sa bon so sor thim// sa bon gsum po 'od 'bar zhing*// brjid bcas de la sems gtad nas// 'phro rgod bcad la 'bad pas bsgom// slar yang sa bon steng nas rim// bsdus nas hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu dang*// khog pa mgo bo zla tshes dang*// thig le nā dar rim bsdus nas// nā da'ang dmigs med ngang du yal// dus gsum rtog pa mi spro zhing*// bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang nyid du// ci gnas mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// thun bcu gcig pa'o| |rjes la 'khor gsum yongs dag pa'i// bsdo bas rgyas btab spyod lam sogs// chos spyod bcu la 'bad de 'jug

/de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi// phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas 'di// mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i// gsung gi gnang ba ji bzhin du// ma bskyud legs par bris pa yang*// chos kyi grags pa'i blo gros yid// rnam par dkar las 'di byung gi// 'gro rnams byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo// //maṅga laṃ//
